name: Davnet
summary: ASX-listed (Davnet Ltd, DVT) high-speed wireless/communications business; its DavTel arm (est. 1998) ran ISP/datacentre/voice, acquired Magna Data Feb 1999; receivership 2001; NTT Australia took DavTel (49% Dec 1999, 51% 2001); Davnet renamed DVT Holdings 2002 then UXC 2002.

events.details: Listed Jan 1997 as Davnet Ltd (ex-Golden Hills Mining).
DavTel to NTT Australia; shell renamed UXC.
